title: The Fight for the Future of Democratic Foreign Policy
gist: Teaser excerpt only: Thomas Wright argues the midterms open the Democratic Party's 2028 presidential campaign, which will be one of the most open contests over Democratic foreign policy in generations, and warns the 2029 strategic environment is on track to be the most difficult since the height of the Cold War.

insights.claim: The 2026 midterm elections mark the beginning of the Democratic Party's 2028 presidential campaign, which promises to be one of the most open contests over Democratic policy, including foreign policy, in generations.
insights.speaker: Thomas Wright
insights.so_what: Democratic 2028 platform positions on China, trade and defense will start shaping policy expectations early.
